_comment: Atlas Search and Vector Search indexes for the `corpus` collection. These are CLUSTER-LEVEL
resources — the Node driver cannot create them, so they are applied through the Atlas UI
(Database > Search > Create Index > JSON Editor) or the Atlas CLI:
atlas clusters search indexes create --clusterName <cluster> --file docs/atlas-indexes.json
Both must exist before hybrid retrieval works. The ordinary btree indexes are created by
ensureIngestIndexes() in lib/ingest/collections.ts and need no manual step.
NOTE: Atlas Vector Search requires an M10 cluster or above. It is NOT available on the M0
free tier — this is the one hard infrastructure cost in the architecture, and it is worth
confirming the cluster tier before building against it.

fields._comment: Pre-filter fields. Declaring them here is what lets $vectorSearch filter by intent and recency in the same stage instead of over-fetching and filtering after.

definition._comment: The lexical half of hybrid retrieval. This is what handles competitor names, product names, error strings and jargon — the queries where an embedding confidently returns something semantically similar but factually wrong. Roughly a third of the highest-value queries are name lookups, so this is not optional.
